# Test Strategy Review Checklist

Use this checklist before approving a test strategy.

## Project Scope and Objectives

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Project scope, products, systems, and lifecycle are clear. | [ ] |
| In-scope and out-of-scope areas are explicit. | [ ] |
| Project business objectives and critical cross-system journeys are identified. | [ ] |
| User stories and releases are treated as coverage inputs rather than separate strategy scopes. | [ ] |
| Quality objectives are measurable or linked to observable outcomes. | [ ] |
| Assumptions and constraints are recorded. | [ ] |

## Risk and Coverage

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Key business and technical risks are identified. | [ ] |
| Risks have impact, likelihood, priority, or equivalent rationale. | [ ] |
| High-risk areas have planned coverage or documented mitigation. | [ ] |
| Functional coverage is addressed. | [ ] |
| Applicable non-functional coverage is addressed. | [ ] |
| Excluded test types have a documented reason. | [ ] |
| Residual risks have owners or acceptance actions where needed. | [ ] |

## Test Approach and Operations

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Test levels and test types fit the architecture and risks. | [ ] |
| Test design techniques are appropriate for the business rules. | [ ] |
| Environment and platform needs are documented. | [ ] |
| Test data, access, tools, and dependencies are documented. | [ ] |
| Responsibilities and communication paths are clear. | [ ] |
| Traceability from risks and objectives to coverage is defined. | [ ] |

## Readiness and Quality Gates

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Entry criteria are measurable. | [ ] |
| Exit criteria are measurable. | [ ] |
| Suspension and resumption criteria are defined. | [ ] |
| Defect severity and escalation expectations are defined. | [ ] |
| Reporting and release decision inputs are defined. | [ ] |
| Draft blockers and open questions are visible. | [ ] |

## Final Review

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Strategy follows the approved template. | [ ] |
| Claims are supported by provided evidence. | [ ] |
| No unsupported requirements or execution results were invented. | [ ] |
| Handoff to project governance, release tailoring, test-case design, and automation is clear. | [ ] |
| Human owner has approved the strategy or recorded follow-up actions. | [ ] |
